C1.name: 作用范围
C1.definition: 哪些原始权重或子块被分解，其余原样保留
C1.values_and_meanings: S-D：各层down_proj；S-U：各层up_proj；S-QV：各层Q和V；S-Custom：明确列出的其他算子/子块集合

C2.name: 分解结构
C2.definition: 用什么因子连接结构表示C1中的权重
C2.values_and_meanings: F-Matrix：双矩阵低秩；F-MPO：MPO链；F-Tucker：Tucker；其他结构以后明确新增

C3.name: 索引组织
C3.definition: 原权重如何拆维、排列、组织成分解对象
C3.values_and_meanings: L-Native：原二维索引；L-Base：预登记的基本张量布局；L-Alt：替代张量布局；L-Semantic：按head/expert等语义组织

C4.name: 参数共享
C4.definition: 哪些不同位置共用同一份数值因子
C4.values_and_meanings: H-None：不新增共享；H-Head：跨head共享；H-Expert：跨expert共享；H-Layer：跨层共享

C5.name: 容量配置
C5.definition: 各因子、各位置的具体秩或连接宽度
C5.values_and_meanings: R-U：按统一目标压缩比例得到的容量向量；R-N：非均匀容量向量。两者最终都必须记录全部整数秩

C6.name: 独立基底变换
C6.definition: 额外选择、而非由误差目标唯一决定的基底变换
C6.values_and_meanings: B-Identity：无额外变换；B-Fixed：指定固定变换；B-Learned：学习得到的变换

C7.name: 初次构建目标
C7.definition: 第一次求分解时优化什么误差
C7.values_and_meanings: O-W：普通权重重构；O-D：输入对角加权重构；O-C：完整输入二阶矩下的输出重构；O-S：明确公式的任务敏感度加权重构

C8.name: 修复目标
C8.definition: 初次分解之后，继续优化什么
C8.values_and_meanings: T-None：不修复；T-Output：局部输出匹配；T-KL：教师预测KL蒸馏；T-Task：任务损失

C9.name: 修复参数范围
C9.definition: 修复时允许更新哪些参数
C9.values_and_meanings: U-None：不更新；U-Factors：仅分解因子；U-Extended：分解因子加明确列出的其他参数

legal_dependencies: sharing requires explicit groups and compatible shape/semantics
layout must match representation and selected operator dimensions
Tucker requires independent tensorization and all axis ranks
objective-induced scale/whitening is not a second C6 freedom
U-Extended requires a named extra-parameter list
Any repair T-Output/T-KL/T-Task requires U-Factors or U-Extended
C2 determines C3 and C5: matrix ranks, MPO connection widths, Tucker all axis ranks
L-Base/L-Alt require explicit dimension splits and permutations; sharing requires explicit groups
C6 is an extra choice, not uniquely determined by the objective
Basis transformations fully absorbable into factors with no material function/constraint difference are not searched twice
